top_band: yellow-brown tiered thatched conical roof slope from row 2 to row 57 (or to row 49 above the doorway arch)
evidence: The structure shows a large conical thatched roof seen from above/front (rows 2-57) overhanging a cylindrical mud-brick front wall (rows 58-77). Under the thatch eaves at rows 57-60 there is a clear dark eave shadow cast onto the wall, and the doorway (rows 49-76) is deeply recessed with an inner frame and dark interior.

style.evidence: The thatched roof has 6 distinct value steps across its cylindrical form plus individual straw bundle texture in every tier. The mud-brick wall below has directional shading across 3 facets, mortar lines, brick highlights, and a stone plinth base, matching the Beodeul reference buildings in craft and density.
